description: Compact summary of every Goal this Session holds (current Task, open Detour, Tasks with a helper or waiting on the Developer, next Task, decisions and open notes) and the Developer's Standing Instructions. Call it at the start of every conversation and after context compression. With project, another project's Goals and Tasks instead, to change them from here. With for_helper, only the Developer's rules as a block to paste into the brief of a helper agent you start (helpers don't see the Standing Instructions, so include it whenever you brief one).

check.description: Also run the plan check-up and list everything it found.

for_helper.description: Only the rules, as a block for a helper agent's brief: the rules and context for everything, then this project's Standing Instructions, hard rules first.

project.description: Another project's plan to use instead of this one's: its name or ID on the dashboard, or its folder's full path. Changes there are marked as made from this project. Leave out for this project.
